name: core.openwop.workflows.seo-content-ops
description: SEO content-ops chains (RFC 0013): a research-grounded content pipeline — a keyword brief from live search, a drafted article for human review, and an on-publish internal-link suggestion pass. Drafts are reviewed before anything is treated as final. Replay-deterministic.
author: openwop

chains.label: Topic → Research-Grounded Brief
chains.description: Researches a topic with live web search and produces a keyword-targeted content brief (angle, outline, target queries, sources) as a saved draft for the writer.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

triggerEventName.description: Host event name that starts this workflow (e.g. `crm.deal.won`).

config.systemPrompt: You are an SEO content strategist. From the search results, write a brief for an article on {{params.topic}}: primary + secondary target queries, a distinct angle, a section outline, and the sources to cite. Ground every claim in a result; never fabricate a source. If the search results' `engine` field is 'demo' or 'stub' they are PLACEHOLDERS, not research: do not treat them as findings or invent specifics from them — say plainly that live web search is not configured (a 'web-search' key on the keys page unlocks it) and stop there.

chains.label: Brief → Draft → Publish Gate
chains.description: Turns an approved brief into a full first draft, then holds it at a human publish gate — the article is never treated as live until a person approves.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

triggerEventName.description: Host event name that starts this workflow (e.g. `crm.deal.won`).

config.systemPrompt: Write a complete first draft from this content brief in a {{params.voice}} voice. Follow the outline, weave in the target queries naturally (never keyword-stuff), and cite the brief's sources. Flag any section where you lacked source material rather than inventing it.

config.title: Review the draft — approve to mark it ready to publish
